close_reason: documented purpose in both backend traits
description: Both ChatBackend and MailBackend define fn supports_type<O: JmapObject>(&self) -> bool. Neither register_chat_handlers nor register_mail_handlers calls this method before dispatching. The register_*_handlers functions register all method names unconditionally — a backend that returns false for, say, SpaceBan still gets SpaceBan/* dispatched to it. Consumers who implement supports_type=false for a type and expect the handler to be absent will get serverFail from a handler that calls a backend method that panics or returns an error. The method is public API with no enforcement: either remove it (if it has no use) or have register_*_handlers consult it.
title: ChatBackend/MailBackend::supports_type undocumented and unused in handlers
